title: Sky Elements drones fall from the sky over the East Field

tellings.quote: all of them start behaving mysteriously and start dropping like bricks from the sky.

plain: A businessman named Brandon Fugal, who owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a drone flight there between about 2023 and 2025. He says a fleet of drones from a company called Sky Elements flew over a part of the ranch called the East Field, then all started acting strangely and dropped like bricks from the sky. He tells it as a sign that something on the ranch interferes with machines.
